    StartersKFBR392 chilli nutsHoney chilli rosemary nuts and jerky. Say KFBR392 till they're gone.How to make it400g mixed raw nuts2 tbsp honey1 tbsp olive oil1 tsp chilli flakes1 tsp smoked paprika1 sprig rosemary, chopped1 tsp sea salt flakes150g beef jerky, slicedToss the nuts with the honey, oil, chilli, paprika and rosemary.Spread on a lined tray and roast at 170°C, stirring twice, until golden.Sprinkle with sea salt while hot and cool so the coating crisps.Serve in a bowl next to the sliced jerky.Old celery trick with blue cheese dipCelery, thick end first, with blue cheese dipHow to make it100g blue cheese100g sour cream3 tbsp mayonnaise3 tbsp buttermilk1 tsp lemon juice1 bunch celery2 carrots1 tbsp hot sauceblack pepper, to tasteMash the blue cheese with a fork, then mix in the sour cream, mayonnaise, buttermilk, lemon juice and pepper, leaving some chunks.Chill the dip.Trim the celery and carrots into long sticks and keep in iced water so they stay crisp.Spoon the dip into a bowl, drizzle with hot sauce and serve with the drained sticks.Homemade C-4 sausage and pepper skewersRigged up at Vicki's after she patches his leg.How to make itA house standard, not part of tonight's cook.Off the GrillAction hero rib eye with onion ringsGrilled rib eye with garlic parsley butter, battered onion ringsHow to make it60g butter, soft1 garlic clove, crushed1 small bunch parsley, chopped150g plain flour1 tsp baking powder250ml cold soda water2 large onions1 L vegetable oil, for frying4 rib eye steaks (300g each)100g rocketMash the butter with the garlic and parsley.Whisk the flour, baking powder and soda water into a batter.Slice the onions into thick rings, dip in batter and fry in the vegetable oil at 180°C until golden. Drain.Season the steaks and grill over high heat for medium rare.Rest the steaks, top with the garlic butter and serve with the onion rings and rocket.Piper's human shield chicken souvlaki with tzatzikiChicken in pita with tzatziki, vest not includedHow to make it800g chicken thigh fillets, cubed2 lemons2 tsp dried oregano3 garlic cloves, crushed3 tbsp olive oil250g Greek yoghurt1 Lebanese cucumber, grated4 pita breads2 tomatoes, sliced1 red onion, thinly sliced600g frozen chipsMarinate the chicken in the juice of 1 lemon, the oregano, 2 garlic cloves and the oil, then thread onto skewers.Bake the chips to the packet directions.Squeeze the cucumber dry and mix with the yoghurt, the last garlic clove and a squeeze of lemon.Grill the skewers until charred and cooked through.Warm the pita and fill with chicken, tzatziki, tomato, onion and a few chips.Sweet StuffX-5 warhead countdown chocolate potsDark chocolate cream pots topped with whipped cream, sea salt, honeycombHow to make it400ml thickened cream2 tbsp caster sugar200g dark chocolate, chopped1 egg yolk1 tsp sea salt flakes30g honeycomb, crushed1 pinch saltHeat some of the cream with the sugar until just steaming. Pour over the chocolate, leave a minute, then stir until smooth and glossy.Whisk in the egg yolk and a pinch of salt. Pour into small glasses.Chill until set.Whip the remaining cream and top each pot with cream, sea salt and crushed honeycomb.Cold DrinksVicki St. Elmo's debrief micheladaBeer with lime, tomato juice and hot sauce over a chilli salt rimHow to make it1 tbsp sea salt1 tsp chilli powder3 limes240ml tomato juice1 bottle hot sauce1 bottle Worcestershire sauce4 bottles of cold lager (330ml each)1 bag iceMix the salt and chilli powder on a saucer. Rub a lime wedge around each glass rim and dip into the salt.Fill the glasses with ice. Add lime juice, tomato juice, a couple of dashes of hot sauce and a dash of Worcestershire to each.Top each with a bottle of cold lager, stir gently and serve with a lime wedge.Trailer step ginger beer with limePiper's order, beers outside MacGruber's trailer.How to make itA house standard, not part of tonight's cook.
